When we unlink a platform account from your account, you will be able to link that platform account to another PRS-ORG Account, but your in-game progress will not transfer over.
That means you’ll lose access to all entitlements, games, memberships or subscriptions, and in-game purchases that are associated with that platform account.
You will also permanently lose all game progress.
If we unlink a platform account you use to PRS-ORG, and that platform account is still set as active in the Web or PRS-ORG App, you will lose access to those apps entirely on your account.
If we unlink a platform account you use to PRS-ORG, you may have issues with Battle Pass leveling, item unlocks, and other errors.
Once you unlink a platform account from your PRS-ORG Account and link it to another, you won’t be able to unlink it again for six months.
You also will not be able to link it to an PRS-ORG Account that has already had the same type of account linked to it before, even if there isn’t one currently linked.
That means if you’ve had an PRS-ORG account linked to your PRS-ORG Account in the past, you can’t link a different PRS-ORG account to it in the future.
